question: After pushing A, B and C, which item does top point at?

beats.speaker: interviewer
beats.line: After pushing A, B and C, which item does top point at?

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: Top points at C, the most recently pushed item, sitting above A and B.
beats.source_quote: pushing C sets top to 2, so top is always the index of the item that would come off next
